evidence.name: Screen field: List of options or number range
evidence.userNeed: Know what "List of options or number range" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: List of options or number range
sections.description: Sets how this wheel's values are built: List means you type each option yourself (sizes, labels, months), while Range means you set a from/to span and the wheel fills in every number between, such as 1 to 10. Use List for arbitrary text choices and Range for evenly-spaced numbers. Note that switching between them clears the options you've already entered for this wheel.
